# ORVUM

> ORVUM is an AI-native retail operating system in development: one intelligence layer intended to connect buying, purchase orders, receiving, inventory, POS/mPOS, sales, returns, clienteling, finance, analytics and owner decision support. The initial focus is premium and luxury multi-brand retail. ORVUM is based in Cyprus. Its founder, Ilya Loshak, has a background in premium multi-brand retail.

Status: in development. Prototypes and product designs shown on the website are illustrative and are not released functionality. ORVUM does not publish customer, revenue or ROI figures.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.orvum.com/): what ORVUM is and the modules it is designed to connect
